```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

# Reading in data
```{r}
policy_eval <- read_csv('results/policy_evaluation.csv')
head(policy_eval)
spec(policy_eval)
simulation_trace <- read_csv('results/policy_summary.csv')
head(simulation_trace)
spec(simulation_trace)
```

# Initial visuals

```{r}
policy_eval |> 
    group_by(policy) |> 
    summarise(max(max_queue))
```


```{r}
y_col_names <- colnames(policy_eval)[c(3,4,5,6,7,8)]
for (col_name in y_col_names){
    # print(col_name)
    ggplot(policy_eval,aes(x=replication,color=policy))+
        geom_point(y=policy_eval[col_name])
}
# policy_eval |> 
#     ggplot(aes(x=replication, y=max_queue,color=policy)) +
#         geom_point()
```
